pages.title: Tier Overview
pages.text:
Normal dolls: 5 tiers. Higher tiers = more health and stronger regen.

Tier 1: 20 HP
Tier 2: 40 HP, Regen I
Tier 3: 60 HP, Regen II
Tier 4: 80 HP, Regen III + Resistance I
Tier 5: 100 HP, Regen IV + Resistance II

All tiers can use all 8 work modes. The Warden Doll (200 HP) is a separate endgame variant.

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: 4 crafting tables surround 1 chest in a cross pattern.

pages.title: Upgrade Path
pages.text:
Place the current egg in the center of a crafting table, surround with 8 materials. The upgraded egg summons a new doll that inherits the name and settings.

T1 → T2: 8 copper ingots
T2 → T3: 4 copper + 4 iron
T3 → T4: 4 iron + 4 gold
T4 → T5: 4 iron + 2 gold + 2 diamonds
